what: Several reel cells spin the same image strip at one turn per 2s. The moment the lever tips to −70° over .8s and returns in .5s, each cell speeds up by 2.5+.5i times, then after 2+.5i seconds stops one after another on the chosen image with .7s power3.out. The step type rolls each cell five turns at .1s intervals on every signal (fx:spin · press) and stops on the next image (1.5+.2i seconds)

options.look: stop (default — spins once on load, then rests) · step (one notch per signal)
options.delay: Seconds until the lever is pulled, default .5
options.fx:spin: Send this event to an element to replay it (step moves to the next slot)
options.[data-fx-part=reel]: Reel cell (child) — children inside form an image strip

note: When finished, the element fires an fx:done event. Cell height is measured from the first image height.

from.where: index.js #op-loading (first page slot loader — three reels·lever) · [data-reel] (small reel that spins on every photo change, step type)
